Bangalore real estate portal (maxHeap Technologies). Tiger Global was already an existing investor, beside Accel, when both put in the $7.5M Series C of July 2013 (VCCircle), so the firm entered in an earlier round the record does not name: stage undetermined. Tiger led later rounds (Rs 64 crore in January 2014; the $30M Series E of September 2014). Quikr bought CommonFloor in 2016: acquired.

Mountain View data-streaming company, listed on Nasdaq in June 2021 and bought by IBM, which completed the acquisition on 2026-03-17 (IBM's release, cited by the Benchmark and Sequoia books): acquired. Tiger Global PIP XII-6 LLC is listed among the investors in the rights agreement of 2020-03-20 that accompanied the Series E, so Tiger held preferred stock by then; whether it bought Series E shares or earlier shares on the secondary market is not stated, and both read Growth (model, medium).

Berlin headless content platform. Tiger Global's private-equity arm led the $175M Series F of July 2021 at $3B (Wikipedia), the first round naming the firm. Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to buy Contentful on 2026-06-01 (Web CMS) and the purchase completed in September 2026 (Dealroom's deal record): acquired, as the Balderton, Benchmark, General Catalyst and Point Nine books read. The Wikidata DE claim is confirmed.

São Paulo digital bank for small businesses (TechCrunch). Greenoaks led the $116M Series B of August 2021 with Tiger Global and Tencent joining as new investors; the $26.7M Series A of April 2021 was led by Ribbit (TechCrunch). The Wikidata Canada claim is a join on another company, disputed. The Y Combinator row 'cora' is another company: a name collision, not aligned.

Pakistani bookkeeping and payments app for merchants, Karachi. Tiger Global backed the $11M pre-Series A round of December 2021, its first Pakistan investment, with Better Tomorrow, Firstminute and others (TechCrunch); a pre-Series A round reads Seed. Graduation left for the graduation pass.
